entries.title: A card's thread keeps your place while you read
entries.body: Scroll up in a card's thread to reread an earlier reply, and it stays where you are while the crew works: new messages, a crewmate starting a command and the working line no longer pull you to the bottom. A small arrow at the foot of the thread takes you down, and counts the messages that arrived below. At the bottom the thread still follows, and a reply too long to fit opens at its first line. On the phone, the card's back keeps your place the same way.

picture.alt: A card beside its thread, scrolled up to an earlier long reply, with a small ↓ 2 new button floating over the foot of the messages.
